selected.focus: A dominant points toward a chord inside the key
selected.cue: Listen for A dominant seventh harmony in the second half of excerpt bar 2, followed by D minor in bar 3. Its C-sharp points toward D even though the passage begins in F major.
selected.credit: Community MIDI via BitMidi; original transcriber not identified
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
selected.note: A roughly 3:13 community arrangement was fetched. This four-bar excerpt contains F, E minor seventh, A dominant seventh and D minor harmony. At source beat 26 the accompaniment contains A/C-sharp/E/G; at 28 it contains D/F/A. The title refers to the work, not an approved transcription of the original recording. Extra accompaniment, the later flute line and drums are omitted. Expressive melody timing is retained; the piano roll remains available if notation cannot represent a fine subdivision.

selected.credit: Community arrangement hosted by Penceland under Miles Davis; arranger unverified
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
selected.note: A valid 4:15 arrangement was fetched. Its guitar-led setting and roughly 108 bpm differ from the original album arrangement; the source page does not identify the arranger. A separate Jazzomat download is a trumpet solo only and was not substituted for the theme.

selected.credit: MIDI DB / Hit Trax provider demo DW0254
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
